name: RUAF Come Home!
html:
Fika has been tested and is supported by both this and UNTAR Go Home, my other faction mod. Make sure this and all dependencies are correctly installed on the host, connecting players, and headless if you use that. Also make sure WTT Common Lib is updated to the latest version that supports Fika. When you do all that, things should work properly!

RUAF Come Home! adds RUAF as a proper faction to SPT. Encounter patrolling squads of soldiers. They have orders to shoot U∗∗∗ on sight, so be careful! If you’re a B∗∗∗, they’ll show you more tolerance, but keep your distance.

INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS

Note for Fika

The client-side portion of this mod and its dependencies are required on all connecting clients, the host, and headless if you are using that. Make sure everyone has the plugin and patcher correctly installed before using on Fika.

RUAF Come Home! requires BigBrain, MoreBotsAPI, and WTTCommonLib to run. Waypoint is not required currently but recommended. I also recommend SAIN for enhancing the combat behavior of the RUAF bots and for configuring their characteristics. There is also support for Couturier, using some clothes from that mod!

Note on uninstalling when using SAIN

name: UNTAR Go Home!
html:

Fika has been tested and is supported by both this and RUAF Come Home, my other faction mod. Make sure this and all dependencies are correctly installed on the host, connecting players, and headless if you use that. Also make sure WTT Common Lib is updated to the latest version that supports Fika. When you do all that, things should work properly!

Yet they’re still here in T∗∗∗∗∗…

UNTAR Go Home! adds UNTAR as a proper faction to SPT. Encounter roving patrols of peacekeepers. Their ROE states that they are only to shoot if threatened, so try not to piss them off!

A client and server API that makes making custom bots a little less infuriating. Create a prepatch and server mod that implements this API and you’ll have the basis for introducing new bosses, factions, and any other custom bot you can think of (maybe, this is still T∗∗∗∗∗).

Fika compatible confirmed for version 1.1.0. Make sure you install properly on all clients, the host, and headless with the latest dependencies for any mod that implements this API.

DISCLAIMER

This repo uses the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 License. To implement this API in your own mod, please contact me first for permission. This API does a lot and has the potential to break other mods and people’s games when used incorrectly. In addition, overriding another mod’s WildSpawnType enum values or vanilla values will cause MANY problems and create a headache for everyone involved, trying to find out what exactly is going wrong for users. In addition, this will make it easier for me to track what WildSpawnType enums are being used so there’s no future conflicts.

name: SPT-VR
note: reader says Needs: advice about running a headless, not this mod - harmless, a badge only
html:
• In SteamVR settings, go into your t∗∗∗∗∗ video settings and set the resolution in there to 100-150%. This is one of the things that hurts performance the most, the lower the better. You need a lot of VRAM if you want to run this at a high resolution (keep in mind if you’re using an upscaler, this setting plays together with that)
  • Learn how to use a headless Fika client, I don’t recommend running headless through your own PC but it can help performance, just make sure you have AT LEAST 64GB of ram. In reality, you should run a headless client on a separate PC on your network that has at least 32GB of ram and a decent CPU
  • Install a bot spawner mod such as MOAR or ABPS, these are also big helps to performance because the main killer of performance in SPT is the AI. These mods are much better at managing spawns.
  • Last thing I’d suggest which may not apply for many people, I disable my 4k monitor whenever I play which seems to help a bit.

    • Minimum CPU - Really I can’t recommend anything other than the AMD X3D chips like the 5800x3d, 9800x3d, etc

    Minimum RAM: 32GB if you have a secondary headless PC, if you’re self hosting you should really have more than 32GB

    Minimum drive - SSD or NVMe SSD, preferably NVMe but this isn’t a big deal

    You may be able to get away with slightly lower specs but this is what I recommend to have an actual playable experience.

name: WATCHDOG - The Headless Client Operations Suite
html:
WATCHDOG is a lightweight, set-and-forget utility built to manage and stabilize an SPTarkov + Project FIKA server environment.

It monitors both the SPT Server executable and the FIKA Headless Client, fully automating startup, shutdown, crash recovery, and scheduled restarts according to your settings.

This tool is designed specifically for 24/7 dedicated servers running on a separate machine (second PC, mini-PC, old laptop, etc.).
It is not intended for local single-PC setups, if you run everything on your main gaming PC, this program is overkill.

Installation

  • Set your Server Executable and HeadlessManager Executable paths.
  • Configure the runtime settings:
    • Headless Start Delay (seconds) — Recommended: 30–60 seconds (gives the server time to fully load, heavier mod load = more time needed).
    • Scheduled Restart Interval (hours) — Default 24. Heavily modded servers are recommended every 4–12 hours for stability and memory cleanup.
    • Monitor Check Interval (seconds) — How often the program checks process health (5–30 seconds recommended).
      • Server, Headless, and Monitor status (green = running, red = stopped)
      • Next Scheduled Restart time
    • Click Start Monitor on the Dashboard.
    • The server and headless client launch automatically.
    • WATCHDOG keeps everything alive 24/7, auto-restarts on crashes, and performs scheduled restarts.
    • If tray mode is enabled, it minimizes to the system tray. Right-click → Show to restore it.

Presets keep settings and zones together: save your own setups, switch between addons, or export a complete preset to share. Editing Default or an addon creates a personal Custom copy. Your existing 2.0 settings and zones migrate automatically.

html:
To change how much fits, open UH-60 Services in the dashboard and adjust Cargo Grid Columns and Cargo Grid Rows. Columns support 1–10, rows support 1–30, and 0 keeps the native size for that dimension. Changes apply the next time the cargo screen opens. Larger items take up more cells, so this changes inventory space rather than setting a fixed item count. These settings are also available as GridWidth / GridHeight under priorityExfil in SIC’s native editor.

name: Vanguard
html:
Standalone, Fika & Headless

Vanguard has validated execution paths for standalone SPT, Fika Host and Fika dedicated Headless.

Fika is required only for Fika topologies. Operator state and squad behavior use the appropriate authoritative execution path for the selected topology.

  • Fika Host
  • Fika dedicated Headless

    • Fika is required only for Fika topologies.

    The distributed Headless configuration has historically received the deepest validation.

    The release-specific dependency table defines the exact versions supported by the shipping build.

    Fika Core / Fika Server — SPECIFIC
    Required when playing Vanguard through a Fika topology. It is not required for standalone SPT.

    Fika Headless — SPECIFIC
    Required only when using a dedicated Fika Headless instance.

    MoreBotsAPI role allocation

    Vanguard includes an in-raid Tactical Editor for creating tactical zones and Operator positioning slots directly inside EFT.

    Works on Standalone SPT, Fika Host and Fika dedicated Headless.

    Quick start

      When the editor is closed and automatic authored zone occupancy is enabled, Vanguard reloads the saved map in raid. When the player owner enters one of those zones, Vanguard activates that authored zone automatically.

      In a Fika dedicated-Headless topology, the authoring snapshot carries the player’s profile ID. The Headless authority then resolves only the Operators attached to that owner profile before assigning authored slots.

      This keeps tactical placement owner-scoped in multiplayer: one player’s active authored zone cannot steer another player’s Operators.

      There is no separate manual Headless reconciliation command. Authoring changes are synchronized through the live transport while the editor is open, and saved-zone occupancy is republished automatically when the editor is closed and the owner enters an authored zone.

      Storage note

      Owner scoping describes runtime authority. The current saved authoring file itself remains local to each game installation and map under:

    1. If you use Fika, install the Fika versions listed for the release.
    2. Stop SPT, EFT and any Fika Headless process before copying files.

    The public Vanguard archive is intended to be installed from the SPT root rather than by manually distributing individual Vanguard binaries.

    Fika dedicated Headless

    1. Install the required SPT/AI dependency stack.
    2. Install the release-compatible Fika Core/Server stack.
    3. Install the compatible Fika Headless package on the dedicated Headless instance.
    4. Deploy Vanguard to the server/client/Headless locations specified by the release package.
    5. Start the server and Headless environment, then join with the player client.
    6. Confirm Vanguard Operator runtime/HUD state is available in raid.
  • Support tactical assignments, opportunistic sustainment and future player-issued squad orders
  • Maintain persistence and runtime authority across Standalone SPT, Fika Host and Fika dedicated Headless
  • Provide the stable foundation required by future Vanguard systems
  • Check the published compatibility information and any player-visible Known Issues.
  • Note whether you are using standalone SPT, Fika Host or Fika dedicated Headless.
  • Identify other mods that can control allied PMCs, squads, spawning, navigation or AI behavior.

    • Required logs — Fika dedicated Headless

    Attach:

    1. The player client’s <SPT>\BepInEx\LogOutput.log.
    2. The dedicated Headless instance’s <Headless SPT>\BepInEx\LogOutput.log.
    3. The current <SPT Server>\user\logs\spt\spt*.log.
    4. <SPT Server>\user\vanguard\operators\vanguard-server.log.

    Because the player-client and Headless files have the same filename, label the two LogOutput.log files clearly when attaching them.

    Controller-status files, Raid Review data and other extended diagnostics are not required for the initial report unless support specifically asks for them.

name: Map Variants
html:
• Whoever starts the raid chooses, and the server records it.
  • A Fika headless asks the server what it is serving, so a headless can host either version.
  • A joining client does the same, so it follows the host rather than its own settings.
  • A transit is decided by the first player into the zone, and everyone who joins is told what they joined rather than being asked again. Only the map the transit actually leads to is offered.

name: Don't Collect My Garbage
html:
But, if you have sufficient RAM headroom, you may be able to run your whole raid without this additional garbage collection, and enjoy a few less stutters.

This is working well on my setup, which is FIKA headless + graphical client on the same host with 64GB RAM; this mod on the graphical client (only, it’s useless on the headless).

Why NOT

Guess what happens if you run out of memory and the game can’t GC? Yeah, bye raid. It’s not a good trade-off for a few less 50ms frames.

You probably shouldn’t be using this if you don’t know how to install it.

FIKA: only install on graphical clients, it is useless on the headless, where I’m sure FIKA has its own GC shenanigans, in addition to its automatic restart after every raid.

name: Sharper Tushonka Better Life
html:
Hey! This is NOT A MOD. This is a ReShade preset, meaning this is compatible with all versions of SPT/EFT.

Drag and drop the contents of the SharperTarkovBetterLife.7z file into your root game folder so that dxgi.dll is in the same directory as EscapeFromTarkov.exe.

If you wish to uninstall, delete the files that are added by this preset.

You do not need any mods such as Amand’s Graphics to use this preset, However, it is highly recommended. I wouldn’t recommend using any other methods of sharpening such as any present in EFT’s settings and so on. This doesn’t reduce performance unless you are GPU bottlenecked.
